event.description: Join us for our second hosted Store Championship here at Evergreen Games Shoppe in Converse, TX. Entry fee is $35. This will include your event promo, 2 booster packs from our available stock, as well as tossing 4 packs into the prizing pool for the event itself with these packs ranging from older 1st editions to Radiant Origins packs.. Entry will net you a raffle ticket into some goodies, such as the RDO Foil poster of Guo Jia featuring her Ultimate art, as well as other game accessories! Additional tickets may be purchased for $1 apiece and this give away will be done at the end of Swiss going into our Top Cut. Swiss Best of 3 with a top cut of at least 4 and up to 8 at the minimum attendance for it. Minimum of 4 Swiss rounds.
